By-name worlds keep vitamin C for the gums and the hair signs; worlds that reach them through scurvy's missing vitamin become not known. The kept by-name facts suggest but do not entail the deleted fact (a symptom can have several causes), so a model that re-infers vitamin C from them is the risk this record measures.
